Stream ensures complete event arrives after all page events

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"max_concurrent\":1,\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
url_req = %Crawlberg.CrawlStreamRequest{url: url}
result = Crawlberg.crawl_stream(engine, url_req) |> Enum.to_list()
IO.inspect(result.stream.has_complete_event)
IO.inspect(result.stream.has_page_event)
IO.inspect(result.stream.event_count_min)
```
